thread:
people-ops: Quick update — Rebecca Stone is joining Redwood Inference as Director, Platform Reliability, starting 2026-05-04. She'll own the reliability & observability stream and the incident playbook work. Diego will transition some of his platform reliability responsibilities to Rebecca over the next 6 weeks as he moves into the SVP, Product Ops role. :tada:

Aisha Patel: Huge win, congrats Rebecca! Recruiting note: we will open two Sr Eng Manager backfills (reliability & observability) and a PM II to cover ongoing runbook/prioritization work. I'll post req owners and hiring timelines by EOD.

Evan Carter: Can you confirm headcount codes and whether these are net-new or repurposed slots? We need to align budget for Q3.

people-ops: Evan — both eng manager roles are backfills (repurposed within platform headcount). PM II is a newly approved slot for Q2 hire. HC codes: ENG-PLAT-001/002 (backfills), PM-PLAT-007 (new).

Diego Morales: Thanks all — Rebecca has been a partner for years, excited to handoff. I'll run a 1:1 transition doc and a short list of current cross-team commitments. Goal: handoff completed by 2026-06-15.

Rebecca Stone: Hi everyone — thrilled to join Redwood. My immediate priorities: 1) stabilize high-severity alert noise, 2) finalize observability SLAs, 3) streamline incident commander rotations. Happy to meet teams next week for quick syncs.

Lina Chavez: Rebecca welcome! I'll set up a 30-min intro with infra and runtime next Tue. Also happy to shadow for the first few incident rotations.

Priya Natarajan: For the backfills — do we want to run internal first-degree referrals? We have a few strong internal candidates in eng-runtime.

Aisha Patel: Yes please run internal referrals first. Hiring plan: week 1 internal screen, week 2 onsites (panel standard: eng lead, reliability SME, product partner, people-ops).

HiringBot: Reminder: create the interview rubric in Greenhouse and tag "Platform Reliability". Deadline: 2026-04-10.

Evan Carter: Rebecca — any specific interview questions or tech areas you want emphasized for the Eng Manager roles?

Rebecca Stone: Focus on incident management, postmortem discipline, and observability design. Also look for people who've scaled rotation and runbook automation.

people-ops: Onboarding checklist link: https://redwood.company/onboarding/checklists/platform-reliability. Please add any custom docs under the "Rebecca Stone onboarding" folder.

Aisha Patel: Compensation note — band for Director, Platform Reliability is Level 6, relocation package on a case-by-case basis. People-ops will handle offer details.

Diego Morales: One more — I'll run a customer-impact brief for any outstanding action items needing exec visibility before handoff.

Rebecca Stone: Thanks Diego. Looking forward — feel free to DM me to schedule 1:1s.

Lina Chavez: :thumbsup: We'll coordinate shadowing schedule.

people-ops: Action items: Aisha posts reqs today, HiringBot will remind teams for rubrics, Rebecca 1:1 schedule by next Tuesday, Diego transition doc by 2026-05-15. Congrats all! :confetti_ball:
